page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor operating at 3.4 GHz. Built upon the x86_64 architecture, the instance supplies 128 dedicated vCPUs paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 2.0 GB per core distribution suited for processing-dense environments.

Networking capabilities include a 64 Gbps baseline bandwidth, providing high data throughput for distributed cluster communications. The instance does not include integrated hardware accelerators or local storage disks, necessitating remote block storage for persistence. Additionally, it provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With high core density and a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio, the system offers efficient resource allocation for compute-bound scenarios without the overhead of surplus RAM. The configuration is appropriate for compute-intensive batch processing, software compilation pipelines, distributed analytics, and large-scale application tiers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance driven by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Managed under a KVM hypervisor, it supplies 128 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 2.0 GB per vCPU allocation designed for compute-heavy parallel workloads. The platform delivers 64 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth to accommodate demanding networking and distributed communication tasks. Hardware acceleration is absent with zero GPUs, and no local disk storage is bundled, necessitating network-attached storage for persistent data requirements. The instance also omits complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Delivering substantial compute density without excess memory overhead, ecs.c8ae.32xlarge serves computational fluid dynamics, distributed batch processing, code build clusters, video transcoding, and compute-intensive microservices architectures.
